verdict.rationale: The npx installer path lets you choose which skills to install: the landing page says "Install the ones you want" and "Pick the skills and agents you use," with `npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills` writing editable files into the project. The plugin routes (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot) are explicitly a whole-set, read-only bundle, so selective install depends on taking the npx route. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how skill selection works in the installer (prompt or flags), selective install on the plugin/marketplace routes, and independent hands-on corroboration.
